latest_news.headline: UAE slips hidden tankers through Hormuz
latest_news.text: Reuters: UAE and buyers moved several crude tankers through the Strait of Hormuz with AIS/location trackers shut off, after Iran effectively limited exports and Gulf oil remained bottled up.

latest_news.headline: Israel strikes Beirut for first time since ceasefire
latest_news.text: Reuters: Israel struck Beirut southern suburbs targeting a Hezbollah Radwan commander, threatening the fragile Lebanon ceasefire tied to broader regional de-escalation.

latest_news.headline: Ukraine says Russia spurned ceasefire
latest_news.text: Reuters: Zelenskiy accused Russia of 1,820 violations of Kyiv’s proposed ceasefire, including assaults, drones and air strikes; Moscow warned of possible massive missile attack around Victory Day disruptions.

latest_news.headline: IAEA confirms Zaporizhzhia drone damage
latest_news.text: Reuters/IAEA: drone damage disabled meteorological monitoring equipment at Zaporizhzhia’s External Radiation Control Laboratory; operations otherwise unaffected but nuclear safety risk persists.

latest_news.headline: Afghanistan accuses Pakistan over border attack
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera: Taliban-led Kabul accused Pakistan of killing civilians in a cross-border attack, the latest stress on the fragile China-brokered ceasefire.

latest_news.headline: Iran IAEA access gaps remain unresolved
latest_news.text: Reuters/AP/IAEA-linked reporting keeps Iran’s 60 percent enriched stockpile and denied/limited IAEA access as the core nuclear risk; no fresh test event or higher-level enrichment confirmation found.

latest_news.headline: Oil volatile above crisis premium
latest_news.text: Reuters energy reporting shows oil trading remained volatile amid Middle East disruption; Hormuz risk and Gulf export constraints remain the main escalation channel for global markets.

latest_news.headline: US-Philippines-Japan live-fire drills near Taiwan context
latest_news.text: TaiwanPlus/Reuters context: allied live-fire exercises in the Philippines continue alongside prior PLA blockade-rehearsal activity; no fresh blockade or landing confirmation surfaced.

latest_news.headline: DPRK missile risk residual, no fresh launch
latest_news.text: Reuters/Yonhap/Al Jazeera search results still point to April ballistic missile launches; no confirmed fresh May 8 launch or test event found.

latest_news.headline: Sudan drone campaign remains Red Sea spillover risk
latest_news.text: Al Jazeera: RSF drone/infrastructure strikes around Khartoum/Port Sudan reporting keeps Sudan on the tracker, but as a logistics spillover rather than a nuclear-escalation zone.
